seo.title: Alfonso Durán: branding for bars & restaurants, Miami
seo.description: Alfonso Durán is a Miami graphic designer: logos, menus, coasters, merch, signage and flyers for bars, restaurants, clubs and food brands.

heading: Durán
studio
about.bio: I'm Alfonso, a graphic designer and illustrator in Miami. For years I've drawn the logos, menus, coasters, posters and walls for bars, clubs and restaurants on Miami Beach, and for brands from New York to Las Vegas. I draw a lot by hand, I letter a lot by hand, and I like work that ends up in the real world. I live in Miami with my wife and our two kids.
